ValidationRule.description: Prevents updates to Contact Point Email records when the Usage Type is set to 'Security Email' for CCRM Users
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false && $Permission.CCRM_Skip_Validation = false && $Profile.Name = $Label.CCRM_Profile_Name && NOT(ISNEW()) && ISPICKVAL(UsageType, "Security Email") && Customer_Name__r.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'PersonAccount' && Customer_Name__r.ANZx_Customer__c = TRUE
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not authorized to update Security Email.
